answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every new identity to lock a non-transferable quartz stake before it earns emissions. Each epoch, peer attestations flag template-duplicate answers; detection forfeits that identity's full stake and any linked operator cluster. A zephyr of cloned heads therefore burns one independent stake per head, and saffron referral graphs that share one controller lose the entire deposit set at once, so attack cost grows linearly with farm size and cannot be amortized.
